answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluate the epoch polynomial, proving valid membership without disclosing their identity. RLN messages carry rate-limit nullifiers and Shamir shares derived from the committed secret. Reusing a nullifier within the epoch exposes enough shares to reconstruct the private key, proving duplicate messaging and triggering immediate collateral slashing. The sonnet, onyx, and reef labels can distinguish epochs or test fixtures; they do not alter the cryptographic enforcement.
